resources.title: Bossing Progression In OSRS - Beginner To Pro!
resources.creator: Kaoz OSRS
resources.noteEs: Ruta de progresión de bossing de principio a fin, ordenando los bosses por dificultad y gear necesario. Ideal para saber por dónde empezar en PvM y qué sigue.
resources.noteEn: A bossing progression path from start to finish, ordering bosses by difficulty and required gear. Ideal for knowing where to start in PvM and what comes next.

resources.title: 2025 Bossing Ladder For OSRS - The PVM Bible
resources.creator: Kaoz OSRS
resources.noteEs: Escalera de bossing detallada que cubre cada boss en orden con su gear y estrategia. Referencia larga para planear toda tu carrera de PvM en un solo video.
resources.noteEn: A detailed bossing ladder covering each boss in order with its gear and strategy. A long reference for planning your entire PvM career in a single video.

resources.title: Noob's PVM Bible: Early Goals Guide for Bossing (Normal & Ironman) | OSRS
resources.creator: RiceCup
resources.noteEs: Guía clásica de PvM para nuevos en bossing, con metas tempranas para cuentas normales e ironman. Evergreen: sigue siendo una base sólida para empezar a aprender bosses.
resources.noteEn: A classic PvM guide for those new to bossing, with early goals for normal and ironman accounts. Evergreen and still a solid foundation for learning bosses.

resources.title: Noob's PVM Bible: Boss Progression Guide & Index (Main & Ironman) | OSRS
resources.creator: RiceCup
resources.noteEs: Índice extenso de progresión de bosses con secciones para main e ironman, organizado para consultar boss por boss. Útil como referencia de gear y orden a largo plazo.
resources.noteEn: An extensive boss progression index with sections for main and ironman, organized to look up boss by boss. Useful as a long-term gear and ordering reference.

resources.title: Top 10 Easy Bosses to Start PvMing in OSRS! (PvM Ladder Entry Level)
resources.creator: SmithyTV
resources.noteEs: Los 10 bosses más accesibles para dar tus primeros pasos en PvM, con requisitos bajos y buenas recompensas. Perfecto para perder el miedo a empezar a bossear.
resources.noteEn: The 10 most accessible bosses to take your first steps in PvM, with low requirements and good rewards. Perfect for getting over the fear of starting to boss.
